warnings: The sheet details the same truss mark T1 twice — in steel and as a timber alternative. Recorded as one T1 element (material steel, matching the plan S-04) with the timber version in alternative_timber, so the mark is not duplicated on one sheet (spec §0.3).
Steel sections are kept verbatim in member_sections[].printed_as (angle, double-angle ⊥ and lipped-channel families; the double-angle ⊥ is not one of the steel_section families verified in spec §6a).
The timber purlin is printed 'แปไม้เนื้อแข็ง 1/2"x3"'; a 1/2" purlin is implausible and the '1' of 1½" may have merged into the scan — kept as printed and flagged, not corrected.
